_comment: Golden MQL template substitution vectors. Pinned so operator-authored statements bind identically across releases and implementations. Each 'ok' case compiles 'template', binds 'params', and must produce 'document' — including the TYPE of every bound value, which is the rule most likely to be broken silently: an MQL comparison against the string "5" does not match a numeric field 5, and the query is well-formed either way. 'names' pins the distinct parameter names, SORTED — a template decoded into a mapping has no insertion order to recover, so sorting is the only rule an implementation can honour unconditionally, exactly as for Postgres columns and Redis mapping arguments; binding is keyed by name, so the order changes nothing observable. Each 'error' case must be REJECTED, at compile time unless 'params' is present, in which case at bind time; 'error' is a token the message must contain, matched case-insensitively, so the exact wording is free to differ. Four rules define the whole surface: a string value exactly equal to ':name' is replaced type-preserved; substitution applies to whole values only, never part of a longer string; keys are never substitutable, so a parameter cannot introduce an operator position such as $where or $out; and '::name' escapes a literal leading colon, mirroring the Postgres tokenizer's :: cast rule.

ok.case: a template without placeholders binds nothing
a string parameter stays a string
an integer parameter stays an integer
a zero parameter is bound like any other
a float parameter stays a float
a boolean parameter stays a boolean
a null parameter binds as null
a repeated name fills every position it appears in
a placeholder inside a longer string is left alone
a colon that does not start the value is ordinary text
the double-colon escape yields a literal leading colon
an escaped value is not a placeholder even when the name is bound
substitution reaches into nested documents and arrays
a pipeline-form update is a list at the top level
a whole statement binds its filter and update together

errors.case: a bare colon is not a placeholder
a placeholder name may not start with a digit
a placeholder name may not contain punctuation
a malformed placeholder is caught inside a list
a key shaped like a placeholder is rejected
a placeholder-shaped key is rejected at depth
$function is rejected inside a pipeline stage
a missing parameter is rejected at bind time
an extra parameter is rejected at bind time
